gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.title: %s's Tree
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.second: Second class: levels at half speed, its perks work at half strength
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.none.help: You have no calling yet. Any villager whose trade grows a class can teach it to you: sneak and use them with an empty hand. A cartographer or leatherworker teaches the Thief, a librarian the Mage, Sorcerer or Warlock, a fletcher the Marksman or Ranger, a cleric the Cleric or Paladin, a farmer or shepherd the Druid, a mason the Monk, a smith the Warlord, Brute or Tinkerer, a shepherd the Rider.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.empty: This class's own tree comes in a later patch. Its level and points already count.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.fork: Crossroads: taking this shuts %s until a respec.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.blocked.cla: Not one of your classes' perks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.blocked.for: You took the other road at this crossroads.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.blocked.mov: Learned on your class's tab now.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.keys: Click a perk to see it, click it again to learn it. The wheel scrolls.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.class.none.tip: Set out with no calling. Any villager whose trade grows a class can teach it to you later, for a little silver.
message.jaymoskingdoms.class.none: You set out with no calling yet. Any villager whose trade grows a class can teach you one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.classtree.milesto: Your %s reaches level %s. Press K and open the Class tab to spend the points.
